page_title: STU 3-1 MAI | Stuttgart v Mainz 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Marco Richter (Mainz) gets inside the box and tries to beat Fabian Bredlow with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
87' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick.
86' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 7:8.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Brajan Gruda (Mainz) will replace Josuha Guilavogui.
84' Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
83' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Fabian Bredlow (VfB Stuttgart).
83' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mainz.
82' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
81' Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Here is a change. Deniz Undav is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
76' 3 - 1 Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) is quickest to the rebound inside the penalty area, and he plants a header directly inside the right post.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Angelo Stiller cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' 3 - 0 What a beauty! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) makes contact with a cross on the edge of the box and finishes clinically with a shot inside the left post.

72' What a chance! Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
70' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Robin Zentner is equal to it and makes an easy save.
70' The substitution is prepared. Tom Krauss (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andreas Hanche-Olsen.
68' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Fabian Bredlow was alert and made an astonishing save!
67' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
66' The ball possession at the moment is 59:41.
62' Pascal Stenzel comes off the pitch to be replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
62' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jamie Leweling and he is replaced by Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) coming on for Chris Fuhrich.
57' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
55' The shot by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Fabian Bredlow.

53' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Robin Zentner anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the right side of the target.
53' Anthony Caci (Mainz) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
51' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
50' Deniz Aytekin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Leandro Barreiro (Mainz). Stuttgart are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
48' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
46' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) replaces Merveille Papela.
46' Jan Siewert prepares a substitution. Dominik Kohr is replaced by Leandro Barreiro (Mainz).
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jessic Ngankam leaves the pitch and Marco Richter (Mainz) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+13' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+10' The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
45+7' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

45+6' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Zentner makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
45+4' 2 - 0 A wonderful cross found Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) in the box who shows good control of the ball and sends it inside the right post.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Jamie Leweling slips it to Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box and he finds the left side of the net with a great effort. The score is 1:0.
45' We will have 12 min. of added time.
42' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

40' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post. The ball goes behind for a corner. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.

39' Merveille Papela (Mainz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mainz.
38' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Mainz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

35' Mainz are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The referee blows his whistle, Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
31' A cross from Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
25' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Fabian Bredlow (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.
25' Anthony Caci (Mainz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Mainz win a corner.
22' Merveille Papela (Mainz) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post.
21' The match can continue after the interruption.
10' The game is interrupted.
7' Stuttgart are seeing far more of the ball now.
4' Deniz Aytekin blows the whistle, Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Mainz, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
2' Anthony Caci (Mainz) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

1' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Robin Zentner who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
1' The first half has just begun.
Mainz will kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will officiate today.
